description: Docker images (compose), GitHub Actions, and version variables. PRs are batched weekly to keep the noise down; the lint workflow gates every PR.

packageRules.description: Group patch/minor updates into a single weekly PR; majors stay individual

wg-easy 15 is a rewrite, not an upgrade: it drops nearly every environment variable, moves the config from wg0.json to SQLite, and migrates through an interactive setup wizard. A merged PR would ride the next deploy and bring the VPN up with no peers — taking the offsite Pi, which is only reachable through that tunnel, out of reach. Hold at 14 until issue #48 is done.
Immich pins are managed manually (one-way DB migrations, server & ML must move together — see feedback 2026-07)
